title: Analog Optical Modeling of Anti-de Sitter Space Geometry and Phase Noise Suppression in a Magneto-Optical Cell
summary: A method is proposed for the analog modeling of the geometry of five-dimensional anti-de Sitter (AdSu2085) space using a magneto-optical cell containing a terbium-gallium garnet (TGG) single crystal placed in a longitudinal magnetic field. It is shown that the formal correspondence between the eikonal equation for a photon mode in a gyrotropic medium and the geodesic equation in an effective optical metric allows the propagation of radiation to be interpreted as motion within a curved five-dimensional subspace.
